models.original_source:
sequenceDiagram
    actor Caller
    participant E as Experience
    participant D as Domain
    participant C as Owning core
    participant P as Selected provider
    Caller->>E: Business instruction + authenticated context
    E->>D: Typed command with resource identities
    D->>D: Validate authority, prerequisites and decision
    D->>C: Owning command through matching SDK
    C->>C: Validate and commit supported local effects
    C-->>D: Durable identifiers and current state
    opt External action is required
        D->>P: Provider-specific action through selected port
        P-->>D: Accepted, rejected, pending or uncertain
    end
    D-->>E: Business outcome and correlation
    E-->>Caller: Explain result and next action

stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> PENDING: create provisional aggregate
    [*] --> POSTED: create posted aggregate
    PENDING --> POSTED: confirm
    PENDING --> REVERSED: release pending aggregate
    POSTED --> POSTED: retain original when reversed
    state "Separate POSTED reversal
linked to original" as R
    POSTED --> R: reverse persisted original legs

models.original_source:
sequenceDiagram
    participant D as Contract domain
    participant C as Document core
    participant DB as Durable signature store
    participant S as Explicit sandbox adapter
    D->>C: Submit owned document + signer + tenant + action key
    C->>C: Validate document/provider associations
    C->>DB: Persist immutable binding and pending request
    C->>S: Create synthetic provider request
    S-->>C: Provider request identity
    C->>DB: Retain provider status and provenance
    C-->>D: Authoritative signature request ID
    Note over C,S: PENDING does not auto-complete
    S->>DB: Explicit simulator outcome through supported core path
    D->>C: Verify same tenant/contract association
    C-->>D: Current retained outcome and signing time if completed

models.original_source:
flowchart TB
    A["Approved terms and conditions"] --> B["Agreement and signing evidence"]
    B --> C["Authorized drawdown"]
    C --> D["Payment instruction and financial effect"]
    D --> E["Servicing case and contractual schedule"]
    E --> F["Actual receipts and allocation"]
    F --> G["Balance, delinquency and risk views"]
    D -. "External outcome unresolved" .-> X["Funding exception: preserve references"]
    F -. "Partial / reversed receipt" .-> Y["Allocation adjustment and reconciliation"]

sequenceDiagram
    participant E as Experience
    participant T as Payment TCC hub
    participant S as SCA participant
    participant L as Ledger participant
    participant R as Rail participant
    E->>T: TRY with stable intent
    T->>L: Create pending financial aggregate
    opt Outbound route requires challenge
        T->>S: Create challenge
        S-->>T: Challenge identity and fixture response
    end
    T-->>E: TRYING + payment identity
    E->>T: CONFIRM with response when required
    T->>S: Validate applicable challenge
    alt Valid confirmation
        T->>L: Confirm posting
        opt External route
            T->>R: Submit through selected implementation
            R-->>T: Actual provider result
        end
        T-->>E: Current confirmed result
    else Rejected challenge
        T->>L: Release provisional effect
        T-->>E: CANCELLED in the tested rejection path
    end

sequenceDiagram
    participant C as Coordinator
    participant P as Payments core
    participant L as Ledger
    C->>P: Create exact instruction and stable action ID
    P-->>C: 201 RESERVING with fixed deadline
    C->>P: Claim pending effect at exact version
    P-->>C: Stable effect/participant IDs and fenced lease
    C->>L: Reserve original operation, TTL, fixed deadline
    Note over C,L: A response may be lost after ledger commit
    C->>P: Acknowledge only effect ID, fence, expected version
    P->>L: Reconcile exact original Reserve intent
    L-->>P: FOUND, NOT_DUE, or retained ABSENT_CLOSED
    P-->>C: Verified state, or 202 recovery required
